headline: US Imposes New Sanctions on Cuban Economic Sectors
summary: The United States has issued new sanctions targeting specific sectors of the Cuban economy, further restricting trade and financial interactions.
why: Sanctions are a primary tool of geopolitical policy that directly impact trade flows and the operations of companies doing business in the affected region.

impacts.name: Cuba
impacts.why: Sanctions restrict economic activity and access to international markets.
